name: Koshimizu Sunao
source:
A former homeless apprentice detective.

He is devoted to the protagonist,
but is wary of everyone else.

He has many abilities and virtues,
but is completely unaware of them.

He stubbornly believes that he is an empty person,
with no value whatsoever.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/sunao]Official site[/url]]
